definitions.explanation: A woodwind instrument played by blowing across a hole, typically made of metal in modern orchestras.

examples.japanese: {吹奏楽|すいそうがく}{部|ぶ}でフルートを{担当|たんとう}している。
examples.english: I play flute in the wind ensemble.

examples.japanese: フルートの{音色|ねいろ}は{美|うつく}しい。
examples.english: The tone of the flute is beautiful.

notes:
From English "flute."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・フルートを{吹|ふ}く (to play the flute)
・フルート{奏者|そうしゃ}/フルーティスト (flutist)
・フルートの{音色|ねいろ} (flute tone)

RELATED INSTRUMENTS:
・ピッコロ (piccolo - smaller, higher pitched)
・{尺八|しゃくはち} (shakuhachi - Japanese bamboo flute)
・リコーダー (recorder)

CONTEXTS:
・オーケストラ (orchestra)
・{吹奏楽|すいそうがく} (wind ensemble/concert band)
・{室内楽|しつないがく} (chamber music)

NOTE: In Japanese schools, many students learn フルート through their {吹奏楽部|すいそうがくぶ} (wind ensemble club).

[Register: Neutral]
